title: Score as a saturating newtype
scenario: The game service tracks the player's score, which accumulates from gameplay events such as destroyed asteroids. A raw u32 invites overflow and lets callers confuse the score with other amounts, so the service needs a dedicated Score value whose arithmetic saturates instead of overflowing.
instructions: In src/domain.rs define a Score newtype wrapping u32 with a private field, a ZERO constant, new and value constructors, and a saturating AddAssign impl.

hints.body: Start with a tuple struct with a private field: pub struct Score(u32); then add the constructors.
value(self) -> u32 returns self.0; AddAssign must use self.0.saturating_add(rhs.0) so the score pins at u32::MAX instead of wrapping.
